name: W3 World Championship
epitaph: W3's top title. Its own title page lists Preston Payne, from a battle royal on 29 July 2007, who relinquished it after six days, and then Cody Clark from the four-way of 19 August; the results page of that night calls it the crowning of the first W3 World Champion, which the title page does not. Clark was stripped on 16 September 2007 and Waylon Cash won the vacant belt in the Lion's Den at Extinction on 7 October; the title page, last updated before that, still shows Clark.

name: W3 Television Championship
epitaph: Serenity won it in a battle royal on 29 July 2007 and Heather Phoenix took it on 12 August. She defended it through September and lost it to Kristoph Kahn in a three-fall match at Extinction on 7 October.

name: W3 Suicidal Championship
epitaph: W3's extreme title. Christian Lee won it in a battle royal on 29 July 2007; Spade took it on 19 August and Darkside on 9 September at the Sin pay-per-view, which is not held. Darkside left it in the ring on 30 September and Hell's Keeper won the vacant belt at Extinction on 7 October.

name: W3 Women's Championship
epitaph: Created at Extinction on 7 October 2007, where Annabelle Sanchez won a four-way elimination to become its first champion. The fed's own Women's Champions page is a blank placeholder.
